title: When the Mixtape Burns
author: S. M. Okonkwo
blurb: Vesper Oyelaran, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, has spent ten years being so careful it hurts. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must save the tradition that made the town before the last game of the season.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
